stepable.name: Stepable
stepable.mission: Turn a software team's documentation into interactive onboarding paths with exercises, plus an assistant that answers by citing that documentation.
did: Generated learning paths with AI that go through human review before they are published.
Built an assistant with hybrid search (full text + pgvector embeddings) that drops any citation not backed by a retrieved chunk.
Enforced AI usage limits before every model call.
stepable.boss: Keeping the AI from making things up. If the sources don't hold enough evidence, no content is generated.
stepable.imageAlt: Stepable screenshot: onboarding path with lessons and progress.
galleryAlt: Stepable screenshot: assistant answering with verified citations.
Stepable screenshot: path editor before publishing.

vector-service-api.name: Vector Service API
vector-service-api.mission: A reusable microservice any app can call over HTTP to store documents and search them by meaning, without re-implementing the RAG layer in every project.
did: Designed a FastAPI REST API: collections, ingestion of text, files and URLs (TXT, MD, PDF, DOCX, PPTX, web), semantic search with metadata filters, and selective deletion.
Made embeddings (OpenAI or local MiniLM-ONNX) and storage swappable, behind a BaseVectorStore interface with ChromaDB as the first implementation.
Added configurable chunking, optional Bearer token auth, a Streamlit admin panel and Docker Compose deployment.
vector-service-api.boss: Making one service work for very different projects. Solved by separating the API from the vector database through a backend interface and moving chunking and embeddings into configuration.
vector-service-api.fact: Did you know? This service will be the brain of the Professor, this portfolio's AI-powered NPC.
vector-service-api.imageAlt: Screenshot of the Vector Service API admin panel.

sofonques-explorer.name: Sofonques Explorer
sofonques-explorer.subtitle: NASA Space Apps Challenge 2025
sofonques-explorer.mission: Explore ultra-high-resolution astronomical images with the help of an AI assistant, for beginners and experts alike.
did: Led team Sofonques through the whole hackathon.
Built the Node/Express backend that talks to Gemini: beginner mode with gemini-2.5-flash and expert/multimodal mode with gemini-2.5-pro, with file uploads and a status endpoint.
Coordinated the integration of the 3D galaxy viewer (React Three Fiber), the gigapixel image viewer (OpenSeadragon) and annotations.
sofonques-explorer.boss: Shipping a working, deployed product within the hackathon window while coordinating the team and building the backend.
sofonques-explorer.imageAlt: Illustration of the Sofonques Explorer viewer with a galaxy and the assistant panel.

finance-chatbot.name: Finance Chatbot
finance-chatbot.mission: My first RAG: a chatbot that answers finance questions from documents, built with Chainlit.
did: Put together an end-to-end RAG pipeline: document loading, embeddings and retrieval.
Built the chat interface with Chainlit.
finance-chatbot.boss: Understanding how retrieval and generation fit together. It was the starting point for everything in the Lab.
finance-chatbot.imageAlt: Illustration of a conversation with the finance chatbot.

mesa-espejo.name: Mesa Espejo
mesa-espejo.subtitle: School follow-up dashboard
mesa-espejo.mission: Centralize and track information about schools, incidents, needs and institutional interventions.
did: Built a dashboard with traffic-light indicators and geolocated heat maps using PostGIS.
Developed the referral, screening and institutional calendar modules.
Implemented 4-role access control and full auditing on a normalized 39-table model.
mesa-espejo.boss: Modeling data from many institutions without losing traceability: a normalized 39-table schema with every change audited and role-based permissions.
mesa-espejo.note: Delivered to the Government of Baja California. Shown as a case study with fictional data; the code is not public.
mesa-espejo.imageAlt: Illustration with fictional data: dashboard with traffic lights, heat map and incident table.

reportes-docentes.name: Faculty Reports System
reportes-docentes.subtitle: UABC
reportes-docentes.mission: Digitize how faculty submit and track their activity reports, with deadlines.
did: Built the React frontend and the Node.js API on MySQL 8, with migrations and seeders.
Implemented reporting periods and submission deadlines.
Containerized the system with Docker Compose for development and production, and wrote the database, Docker and deployment manuals.
reportes-docentes.boss: Going from prototype to a system the university uses every day: reproducible deployments and documentation so others can run it.
reportes-docentes.imageAlt: Illustration with fictional data: list of faculty reports with statuses and deadlines.

koa-caffe.name: Koa Caffe
koa-caffe.subtitle: Digital menu
koa-caffe.mission: Give a coffee shop a digital menu that customers open by scanning a QR code at the table.
did: Built a single-page menu with React, Vite and Tailwind.
Published it on GitHub Pages and generated the QR code for the tables.
koa-caffe.boss: Delivering something small, fast and easy to maintain for a non-technical client.
koa-caffe.imageAlt: Screenshot of the Koa Caffe digital menu.

antigravity.name: Antigravity Ecosystem
antigravity.subtitle: Algorithmic trading with a risk agent
antigravity.mission: Trade on MetaTrader 5 with a modular Expert Advisor whose risk is watched by an external agent that blocks trades during macroeconomic news or when data is unreliable.
did: Built the Guardian Agent in Python: async FastAPI API, async SQLAlchemy + PostgreSQL (Alembic) and a LangGraph graph that checks news and the macro calendar and decides the risk state. Fail-closed policy: no reliable sources, no trading.
Designed a multi-mode MQL5 Expert Advisor (single build, per-symbol profiles) with a risk engine, session and spread filters, fail-closed lot sizing and persisted, versioned risk state.
Added per-position telemetry to a data lake with a dead-letter queue and backfill, a Streamlit dashboard, Docker, Nginx for the VPS and GitHub Actions CI (Python and MQL5 builds).
antigravity.boss: Avoiding overfitting. I defined a disciplined baseline → optimization → confirmation → out-of-sample validation method, with one rule: a profile is only frozen with quantitative evidence on its own symbol.
antigravity.note: Presented as a systems engineering project. No returns, balances or accounts are shown.
antigravity.imageAlt: Illustration with fictional data: dashboard with the Guardian Agent status and drawdown.

alerta-acv.name: Alerta ACV
alerta-acv.subtitle: Early stroke detection
alerta-acv.role: Mobile developer · UABC & Mexican Red Cross
alerta-acv.mission: Digitize the FAST protocol to detect early signs of a stroke and assist during the emergency.
did: Implemented real-time face analysis with MediaPipe in a native Kotlin module connected to Flutter through a method channel.
Developed the facial asymmetry, arm drift and speech tests, with voice guidance.
Added automatic calls and SMS to 911 with geolocation.
alerta-acv.boss: Getting MediaPipe to analyze a face in real time inside a Flutter app with acceptable performance on Android. Solved by moving the analysis into a native Kotlin module (CameraX + MediaPipe) connected to Flutter through a method channel.
alerta-acv.imageAlt: Illustration: face, arms and speech test screens, and the emergency button.

walletg.name: WalletG
walletg.mission: A personal finance app to track income and expenses.
did: Built the backend with Django REST Framework.
Developed the React frontend that consumes the API.
walletg.boss: Fully separating frontend and backend, talking through a REST API.
